stemMd: The data set is −8, −3, 2, 4, 11. By how much does its range decrease when its smallest value is removed?
explanationMd: The original range is 11−(−8)=19. After removal it is 11−(−3)=14. The decrease is 19−14=5, not the magnitude of the removed number.
